description: Count active Texas licensees from the TDLR public record by licence type, optionally limited to those whose licence expires before a given date. Answers how many people a rule change, CE requirement or fee change actually affects — the number is not published anywhere in this form.

expiring_before.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Counts only licences expiring before it — use to size who is affected by a change taking effect on that date.

license_type.description: Optional exact TDLR licence type, e.g. "Class A Barber", "Cosmetology Operator", "Cosmetology Manicurist", "Cosmetology Esthetician". Omit for a breakdown across all types.

name: texas_licensee_counts
title: Count Texas barber & cosmetology licensees
